entities.summary:
The Kamtapur Liberation Organisation is a militant organisation based in Northeast India whose objective is to separate the Kamtapur nation from West Bengal and Assam. The proposed state is to comprise all districts of northern West Bengal and four contiguous districts of Assam which are Cooch Behar, Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri, North and South Dinajpur and Malda, Kokrajhar, Bongaigoan, Dhubri and Goalpara, Kishanganj districts in Bihar, and Jhapa District in Nepal.

The KLO was formed to address problems of the Koch Rajbongshi people such as large-scale unemployment, land alienation, perceived neglect of Kamtapuri language, identity, and grievances of economic deprivation. Kamtapur Liberation Organization is a armed organization, established in 1995-12-28. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
